column1: # Stage 1 follow-up: 1 MiB beat the shipped 2 MiB by 11 ms in the coarse sweep, but 512K and
# below are far worse, so the curve has an interior optimum. Find it, and check it at 8 threads
# The surviving hypothesis is per-*cluster* L2, not per-core: an E-cluster is 8 MB shared by 6
# cores, so 6 x 1 MiB of live buffer fits and 6 x 2 MiB does not. That predicts the knee sits
